Café owner honored by chamber

The owner of the Corner Café, José Alvarez, received the chamber of commerce’s community award on Tuesday for twenty years of serving breakfast to early-shift workers at the mill.

Alvarez said he was “humbled and a little embarrassed” by the honor, and thanked his staff, several of whom have worked at the café for more than a decade.

The chamber also recognized the volunteer fire department and the high school robotics team at the ceremony, which drew more than two hundred people to the community center.
